Ah, you're absolutely right! Thank you for the correction. 

`COUNT(column)` excludes NULL values in that column, while `COUNT(*)` counts all rows regardless of NULLs. So in your case:

- `COUNT(email)` = 980 (non-NULL email values)
- `COUNT(*)` = 1000 (all rows)
- 20 users have NULL in the email column

I was incorrect to equate them—they have distinctly different behavior when it comes to NULL handling.
